company.name: AlgoViral
company.shortDescription: AlgoViral provides AI-driven short-form social media growth and advertising services for technology companies and startups.
company.description: AlgoViral provides an AI-driven, data-focused growth platform for technology companies and startups that rely on short-form social media. The company runs the full social growth loop, from identifying trends to creating, editing, and publishing high-volume video content across platforms such as TikTok and Instagram Reels. Its in-house automation tools handle scheduling, distribution, and performance tracking for organic posts. AlgoViral then converts the best-performing content into paid advertising variants, generating and testing many structured iterations. Most media is produced and optimized using proprietary AI systems tuned to social discovery algorithms. AlgoViral focuses on helping clients increase audience engagement and improve conversion outcomes through continuous creative testing and analytics.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform for automated short-form video creation, trend analysis, scheduling, and performance optimization across social channels.
